privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Information

sections.heading: 3. Information Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. Information is only shared with service partners necessary to operate the website (payment processing, hosting infrastructure).

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
sections.body: Your data is stored on infrastructure with encryption and strict access controls. We apply reasonable technical measures to prevent unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
